q: Agar hum kal kisi aur CRM mein shift ho gaye toh complete data kis format mein milega?
Ek staff member galti se export kar de toh access control aur audit trail hai kya?
Former employee ka access turant remove kar sakte hain, ya sabko same admin login dena padega?

a:
Fancy words ke bajay Give Setu mein practical controls milte hain:

- Data, backups aur files India mein held rehte hain.
- PAN column level par encrypted hota hai, transit mein TLS security hoti hai, aur sensitive fields default masked rehte hain.
- Advanced plan mein role-based field masking hai, jisse frontline users ko full PAN ya phone number dikhana zaroori nahi hota.
- Har change ka append-only audit trail record hota hai — kisne, kya, kab aur kahan se change kiya. System mein delete facility nahi hai.
- 15-minute recovery point, quarterly restore drills, 30-day snapshot retention aur accidental deletion ke liye 30-day undo bin hai.
- Har data entry point par DPDP consent capture hota hai.
- Full data export kabhi bhi free hai, isliye data platform par locked nahi hota.

Chhote NGO ke liye Starter mein core security aur data controls milte hain. Agar staff roles ke hisaab se PAN aur phone masking chahiye, to Advanced ka field-level masking relevant hai. Donor data, member records ya compliance data mein se sabse sensitive kya hai?
